authorization_interpretation: Reference past HJB-convergence experiments and design external-price diagnostics. No new worker, initialization, HJB/KFE or automatic successor authorized by this design request.

question: Does replacing household rah .09 with the historically successful .05, holding all other current black-box settings fixed, recover source HJB convergence within100 iterations?

endpoint.primary: Actual source HJB return with converged=true, finite original max(abs(value-old))<1e-7, iterations<=100
endpoint.measurement: Original returned HJB fields and100-scalar progress recorder; not equation residual
endpoint.unit: One deterministic fixed synthetic point, not population/seed samples
endpoint.statistical_testing: NOT_APPLICABLE; no p-values, power or empirical success probability
secondary: Full value-change trajectory and observations at50 if reached
Same-return KFE/aggregates as raw diagnostics only if HJB converged

recommended_next_scope.only_external_difference_from_current: rah .09 -> .05; use the same initializer algorithm, recomputing its price-dependent initial arrays
recommended_next_scope.hypothesis: This one replacement yields the fixed primary endpoint
recommended_next_scope.falsifier: A valid source return after100 iterations remains converged=false/criterion not met; this narrow replacement is not sufficient. Do not infer all prices irrelevant.
recommended_next_scope.inconclusive: Timeout/protection/source/environment/domain/observer/unknown-return event; stop, do not label as100-iteration nonconvergence
recommended_next_scope.success_action: Keep first HJB candidate; optionally complete same-return original KFE/aggregate under the proposed budget, then stop for review. No GE/31-province activation.
recommended_next_scope.nonconverged_action: Save all return/progress evidence and stop. No automatic second price point.
